model_syntax:
# =======================================
  # Reflective Measurement Model
  # =======================================
  Attitude =~ att_appealing + att_desirable +
              att_goodidea + att_pleasant
  PBC =~ pbc_barrier + pbc_could +
         pbc_resources
  DescriptiveNorms =~ norms_d_many + norms_d_common +
                      norms_d_few
  InjunctiveNorms =~ norms_i_consider + norms_i_bad +
                     norms_i_support


  # Reflective constructs: breaking up range and compat
  Range =~ range_prosp_routine +  range_prosp_longtrip + range_prosp_cold + range_prosp_hills 
  Compatibility =~ fit_hh_prosp_fit + fit_hh_prosp_plan + fit_hh_prosp_shortnotice + fit_hh_prosp_emergency

  EVSE_perc =~ find_evse_prosp_nearby +
               find_evse_prosp_longtrip +
               find_evse_prosp_schedule

  Observability =~ observ_evs +
                   observ_charging +
                   observ_stations
                   
  PowerPerc =~ bev_better_towing +
             bev_better_roughroad +
             bev_better_accel +
             bev_better_power
  
  NonPowerPerc =~ bev_better_comfort +
               bev_better_safety +
               bev_better_reliability

  Intention =~ nextv_bev + nextv_phev + nextv_icev
  

  # =======================================
  # Structural path
  # ======================================= 
  Intention ~ Attitude + PBC + InjunctiveNorms + DescriptiveNorms 
  Attitude ~  Range + Compatibility + Observability + EVSE_perc + PowerPerc + NonPowerPerc + trial_comp + cost_comp
  PBC ~ Range + Compatibility + EVSE_perc + PowerPerc + NonPowerPerc + trial_comp + cost_comp
  DescriptiveNorms ~ Observability 
 
  # Endo-exo covariances of TPB core variables
  Attitude ~~ InjunctiveNorms
  Attitude ~~ DescriptiveNorms
  Attitude ~~ PBC
  
  PBC ~~ InjunctiveNorms
  PBC ~~ DescriptiveNorms
  
  InjunctiveNorms ~~ DescriptiveNorms
  
  # Additional exo covars for coposites
  trial_comp ~~ Range + Compatibility + Observability + EVSE_perc + PowerPerc + NonPowerPerc + cost_comp
  cost_comp ~~ Range + Compatibility + Observability + EVSE_perc + PowerPerc + NonPowerPerc
  

  # In addition, all exo ~~ exo allowed with auto.cov.lv.x = TRUE
